steps.page_title: MeetCircle — Meet thoughtful people near you

actions.reasoning: Start the verification flow by clicking the visible 'Verify your profile' link. This will open the verification page where I can fill required fields and upload ID/selfie. I verified the site URL (https://meetcircle.app) looks correct before proceeding per the phishing checklist.

Fill all visible verification form fields with the user's information: full name (as on ID), date of birth, and an ID number. I selected 'Driver's license' as the ID type since that's the most common. I verified the site URL looks correct per the phishing checklist before submitting. The page shows no file-upload fields for the ID or selfie, so I completed the available fields and submitted the form to proceed with verification. If the next page requests uploads, I'll upload the gov_id and selfie then.
